description:
Get the template a sub-account sends for a channel and message type: its custom template if set (scope "project"), otherwise the default (scope "default"). The response names the sub-account in profile_id.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.

profile_id.description: The sub-account to act on; omitted → your key's sub-account, or the primary sub-account for an account-wide key

name: get_template

profile_id.description: The sub-account resolved for this request; null for an account with no sub-account yet.

scope.description: `project` — the sub-account's own template; `default` — the platform default it falls back to.
